text.tspan: Treated Water, Fresh Lemon Juice Reconstituted (6%), Raw Sugar,
Rock Salt (Sendha Namak), Black Salt (Kala Namak), Potassium Citrate,
Natural Lemon Extract. CONTAINS NO ARTIFICIAL COLOURS OR SWEETENERS.
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Refrigerate after opening
and consume within 24 hours. Natural fruit juice may settle — shake gently.

g.text: Crush bottle after use • Clean Amdavad initiative
Hydration backed by science, rooted in desi wisdom
